certification.meaning: PIT=true certifies the recorded public-input chronology, not predictive validity or exhaustive information.
certification.cut_rule: Official BOJ controls cut one second before announced release; communication/operation snapshots target the next scheduled BOJ announcement. Cuts are never chosen to predict an already completed market jump.
certification.first_public_rule: Unknown exact clocks remain null with conservative bounds. Wire original timestamp is not a current-body version certificate.
certification.edition_rule: Dated official releases or supported publisher edition metadata. Unresolved later revisions excluded. No claim of archived byte-identical editions.
certification.selection_rule: Purposeful chronology and discriminating controls, not an outcome-blind representative sample. Repeated articles are not new episodes.
certification.model_rule: M0/M1/M2 schema retained; all abstain because no historical forecast was locked. No Brier/log-score race or hidden-intent probability.
certification.dependence_rule: 15 event rows share10 BOJ targets; summer2026 bargaining rows especially dependent. Never use15 as independent outcome N.
